title: Rams’ presence at Brendan Sorsby’s pro day may be about more than quarterback scouting

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams’ presence at Brendan Sorsby’s pro day may be about more than quarterback scouting
sources.description: The Los Angeles Rams are expected to have a presence at Brendan Sorsby's supplemental draft pro day on July 10, but don't expect Sean McVay and Les Snead to suddenly develop quarterback envy.
